# apicurio_group_rule (Resource)

A rule on a group, applied to every artifact of the group that has no rule of the same type itself; it takes precedence over the global rule of that type. The group must exist (an `apicurio_group`). On a secured registry group rules need the developer role. Rules are applied when a version is created and when a draft leaves `DRAFT`, never to existing versions. See the provider documentation for the precedence of rules and their maturity per artifact type.

## Example Usage

```terraform
# A rule for every artifact of a group that has no rule of that type itself;
# it takes precedence over the global rule of the same type.
resource "apicurio_group_rule" "payments_compatibility" {
  group_id  = apicurio_group.payments.group_id
  rule_type = "COMPATIBILITY"
  config    = "FULL_TRANSITIVE"
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `config` (String) Configuration of the rule, validated against `rule_type`: `VALIDITY` takes `NONE`, `SYNTAX_ONLY` or `FULL`; `COMPATIBILITY` takes `NONE`, `BACKWARD`, `BACKWARD_TRANSITIVE`, `FORWARD`, `FORWARD_TRANSITIVE`, `FULL` or `FULL_TRANSITIVE`; `INTEGRITY` takes a comma-separated set of `REFS_EXIST`, `NO_DUPLICATES`, `NO_CIRCULAR_REFERENCES` and `ALL_REFS_MAPPED`, or `FULL` or `NONE` alone. Changed in place.
- `group_id` (String) Group the rule belongs to. Changing it replaces the rule.
- `rule_type` (String) `VALIDITY`, `COMPATIBILITY` or `INTEGRITY`. Changing it replaces the rule.

### Read-Only

- `id` (String) `group_id/rule_type`.

## Import

Import is supported using the following syntax:

The [`terraform import` command](https://developer.hashicorp.com/terraform/cli/commands/import) can be used, for example:

```shell
# Group rules are imported by "group_id/RULE_TYPE".
terraform import apicurio_group_rule.payments_compatibility payments/COMPATIBILITY
```
